test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Few people are sitting in a row facing north. R is sitting 3rd to the left of U. Only two persons are sitting between R and T. Only one person sits between Q and U. Only one person sits to the right of U. Only V sits to the left of T. How many people are sitting in the row?
solution:
Given: Few people are sitting in a row facing north.

1. R is sitting 3rd to the left of U.

2. Only two persons are sitting between R and T.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18c81dbf0bce73d4288e52be1501c3893201a4fdbfa4aa47a6bbea744d4a67b1.png] 

3. Only one person sits to the right of U. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20db048fed0f16d1ffb37a3cf4c59773b57d77fc46118e8eb5a3fcfde4b4c334.png] 

4. Only one person sits between Q and U and only V sits to the left of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83fd245ceb13484fd9fdabc65efd8040b8c9f3d8beb13c3642445875f9142c77.png] 

Hence, option (2):** 9 ** people are sitting in the row.
